articles.title: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: Litecoin token has its moment as network activity booms
The data proves it: Bitcoin doesn't care about rising bond yields over long-term
articles.snippet: Long-term, BTC ignores rising bond yields. In the short term, however, surging bond volatility could easily dampen crypto's animal spirits.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s ‘last resort’ quantum-safe solution just got 79% cheaper: StarkWare
articles.snippet: A weeklong optimization challenge cut the estimated GPU cost of preparing an experimental quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction to under $67, potentially making the “last-resort measure” a little easier on the wallet.

articles.title: Ex-SEC acting chair: Agency dropped crypto cases to avoid issues with credibility
articles.snippet: SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda said that the agency dropped many cases against crypto companies in early 2025 to avoid potential credibility problems in court.
